subject: DS474
filterSummary: Selected 5 English and 4 Arabic videos for the specified topics. The English selection provides strong coverage with highly relevant and popular videos for all topics. The Arabic selection is also strong, though one topic, 'Types of Data', had no eligible candidates due to a lack of specific, high-quality content. For 'Descriptive Statistics' in Arabic, a practical Excel-based tutorial was chosen due to its comprehensiveness and high viewership.
